name: M3_OIS010MI_LstOrderTypes
description: List customer order types for a company and view the main control settings that govern customer order entry, pricing, logistics, credit handling, statistics, and field display. The operation can either return all existing customer order types for the company or only the specific type and category you request. When you pass a single customer order type together with its customer order category, the call also acts as an existence check: the result is `"OK"` when that combination exists and `"NOK"` when it does not, and the corresponding settings are returned.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number used to select which company’s customer order types are listed.

inputParameters.name: ORTP
inputParameters.description: Customer order type to list; if left blank, all order types are listed.

inputParameters.name: ORTK
inputParameters.description: Customer order category to filter customer order types; if left blank, all categories are included.

inputParameters.name: WODP
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether only customer order types authorized for the current user are listed.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number.

outputParameters.name: ORTP
outputParameters.description: Customer order type.

outputParameters.name: ORTK
outputParameters.description: Customer order category defining the overall purpose of this order type, for example normal, credit, or quotation.

outputParameters.name: NEXT
outputParameters.description: Default next manual processing step after order entry for this order type.

outputParameters.name: TX40
outputParameters.description: Long description of the customer order type.

outputParameters.name: TX15
outputParameters.description: Short name for the customer order type.

outputParameters.name: OT01
outputParameters.description: Controls whether the customer must belong to a business chain when entering orders of this type.

outputParameters.name: CLOE
outputParameters.description: Controls whether a credit check is performed when a new order header is entered for this order type.

outputParameters.name: CLLE
outputParameters.description: Controls whether a credit check is performed when new order lines are entered for this order type.

outputParameters.name: AUBC
outputParameters.description: Controls whether payer block codes are ignored during customer order entry for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT67
outputParameters.description: Controls whether order header and line charges are validated during order entry for this order type.

outputParameters.name: SEAH
outputParameters.description: Defines how season control is applied when entering orders of this type.

outputParameters.name: OT22
outputParameters.description: Number of days added to today’s date to calculate the earliest possible delivery date when none is specified for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT19
outputParameters.description: Defines the search sequence used to identify items entered on order lines for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT73
outputParameters.description: Defines the search order for different alias number types when entering items on order lines for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT11
outputParameters.description: Defines whether positive, negative, or both quantity signs are allowed when entering order quantities for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT66
outputParameters.description: Controls whether duplicate customer orders are checked when using this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT31
outputParameters.description: Defines when automatic price, discount, and VAT are retrieved and which date they are based on for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT12
outputParameters.description: Controls whether the sales price can be changed and whether a zero price is allowed on order lines for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT72
outputParameters.description: Controls whether a default quantity is proposed from assortments, buying patterns, or popular numbers during order entry for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT10
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether deliveries for an order of this type can be made from multiple warehouses.

outputParameters.name: PRMS
outputParameters.description: Sequence defining the priority of different price sources when determining sales prices for order lines of this type.

outputParameters.name: AGCL
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether customer agreement pricing is checked when entering orders of this type.

outputParameters.name: OT63
outputParameters.description: Controls whether contribution margin ratio is checked and whether warnings or blocks are issued when margins are too low for this order type.

outputParameters.name: QLCH
outputParameters.description: Percentage threshold used to trigger quantity limit checks for better price breaks during order entry for this order type.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Default warehouse used for customer orders of this type.

outputParameters.name: TEPY
outputParameters.description: Default payment terms used for customer orders of this type.

outputParameters.name: TECD
outputParameters.description: Default cash discount terms applied to customer orders of this type.

outputParameters.name: MODL
outputParameters.description: Default delivery method used for customer orders of this type.

outputParameters.name: TEDL
outputParameters.description: Default delivery terms that define when responsibility for the delivery is transferred for this order type.

outputParameters.name: CHSY
outputParameters.description: Line charge model defaulted to customer orders of this type.

outputParameters.name: PLTB

outputParameters.name: EXCD
outputParameters.description: Service charge code that may be added when the order value is below a specified limit for this order type.

outputParameters.name: DISY
outputParameters.description: Discount model controlling how discounts are calculated for customer orders of this type.

outputParameters.name: CUCD
outputParameters.description: Default currency code for this order type.

outputParameters.name: ADIL
outputParameters.description: Controls handling of the delivery address on order lines for this order type.

outputParameters.name: FLDS
outputParameters.description: Controls whether the related field is hidden, display-only, or editable for this order type.

outputParameters.name: FLD2
outputParameters.description: Number of decimal places displayed for the related field for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT14
outputParameters.description: Defines how cost prices are handled and controlled for orders of this type.

outputParameters.name: CRTP
outputParameters.description: Exchange rate type used when converting foreign currency amounts for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT17
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether promotions are checked and retrieved during order line entry for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT35
outputParameters.description: Controls whether and how advance invoicing or prepayment requests are used for this order type.

outputParameters.name: OT47
outputParameters.description: Default line type used when creating new order lines for this order type.

outputParameters.name: CAPM
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether cash desk processing is started after order entry for this order type.

outputParameters.name: CLOQ
outputParameters.description: Controls whether a credit check is performed when closing orders or order lines for this order type.

outputParameters.name: PRGU
outputParameters.description: Controls whether price guidance is available when changing prices on order lines and whether details are stored for this order type.

outputParameters.name: MIXO

outputParameters.name: OBPG
outputParameters.description: Lists price origins for which price guidance is not allowed for this order type.

outputParameters.name: ICTR
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this order type is used for internal sales.

outputParameters.name: LS03
outputParameters.description: Controls whether lost sales statistics are updated when discrepancies are reported at completion end mark in picking for this order type.

outputParameters.name: RS03

outputParameters.name: LS04

outputParameters.name: RS04

outputParameters.name: QR15

outputParameters.name: RS15

outputParameters.name: QR16

outputParameters.name: RS16

outputParameters.name: TAGY

outputParameters.name: FLD3

outputParameters.name: BMON

outputParameters.name: DSOL
